name: Jery - Hermes Logs to Review Queue (Draft)

parameters.content:
## Jery: real log candidates → review queue (draft)
Collector API is NOT implemented yet. Set collector_url and select the same Header Auth credential in both HTTP nodes.
The collector must read Hermes in read-only mode, sanitize data, persist pending batches, and atomically upsert review candidates + advance the cursor. Repeated/concurrent requests must be idempotent.
Calls are observations, never verified labels. Human review and final JSONL export are separate steps.
Import inactive; test with Manual Trigger before enabling the schedule.
